name: hmcts-api-marketplace-build
description: Static export and conformance gates for the GOV.UK-conformant HMCTS API Marketplace site. Pages are authored in prototype-kit/; docs/ is generated output and must never be hand-edited.

scripts.kit: cd prototype-kit && PORT=3100 npm run dev
scripts.gates: npm run gate:manifest && npm run gate:translations && npm run gate:structure && npm run gate:html && npm run gate:links && npm run gate:a11y && npm run gate:reflow
